title: MiGDL Delta Operations Game Plan
lede: Visualizes operational progress and outcomes, tied to the technical milestones that unlock each stage, and quantifies the operational KPIs in the scorecard at right. Each stage gets more correct, more performant, and less compute intensive.
companion: Companion to the Change Handling G1-G6 diagram and the Q4 Plan of Attack.
caveat: Throughput figures are estimates from the Aug 2026 throughput one-pager and two measured runs; validate against sys_query_history before treating them as commitments. Draft for team review, Oct 2026.
unreadable: The PDF's text layer has no Unicode mapping for the digits 0, 1, 4, 7 and 8, and the compute dots are indistinguishable filled from hollow. Figures that could not be read are marked rather than guessed.

pipelines.name: Gold & Platinum
pipelines.sub: one Redshift Serverless cluster · every district writes the same 350 shared tables

stages.name: Today
stages.does: Deltas only handle inserts and parent-row updates. Any district needing a child-only update or a delete to propagate gets a full load end-to-end through A and B.
correct: Correct only after a full load

stages.name: Deltas through Silver, full loads through Platinum
stages.does: Silver now applies child-only updates and deletes, so Pipeline A never needs a full load except for a new district. Pipeline B drops deltas and runs full loads only, still one district at a time.
correct: A by delta, B by rebuild
throughput: Unchanged — B still one at a time, min stagger
stages.compute: A full loads gone; every B run is a rebuild

stages.name: End-to-end district batching optimization
stages.gate: Gold batching lands · Silver scaling resolved
stages.does: Two separate optimizations, one per pipeline. Pipeline B full loads run 10-25 districts per trigger instead of one, collapsing per-district COPY cycles and write contention at the boundary. Pipeline A should parallelize to any number of districts (per-district tables, no shared writes), but a spike is uncovering why it cannot today. Both must land for this stage's KPIs to hold.
throughput: Pipeline B at districts / hr per batch at a conservative min stagger
COPYs parallelized regardless of size; sweep time insensitive to row volume
Blocked until Silver scaling is resolved, whatever Pipeline B achieves
stages.compute: Commits per batch instead of per district. Batched deltas through Gold Main, full recompute of Derived + Platinum

stages.name: Target state
stages.gate: G3 + G4 correctness · GM / GD independence
stages.eta: TBD (gold main deltas could be ready in 3 weeks, independent of stage 2)
stages.does: Gold main can apply updates and deletes, so it never needs a rebuild. Derived and Platinum are cleaned and recomputed fully instead of patched by dirty keys (too many overlapping dependencies). If G3/G4 lands before batching, the interim is the same shape at 1 district per trigger.
correct: All change classes, by delta through GM
throughput: Target GM deltas at / hr — remaining cost is the GD / P rebuild
stages.compute: Rebuild limited to the projection layer

g1g2.label: G1 + G2
g1g2.name: Silver delete handling and child-change handling
g1g2.unlocks: Deltas for every change class through Silver.

batching.label: Gold batching
batching.name: Districts share one COPY and one SQL sweep per batch through Pipeline B

silverscale.label: Silver scaling
silverscale.name: Pipeline A's B→S job runs reliably at the district volume Pipeline B can now absorb
silverscale.unlocks: Should parallelize without limit by design; a separate spike is finding out why it does not yet.

g3g4.label: G3 + G4
g3g4.name: Gold update application and delete propagation
g3g4.unlocks: Deltas through gold main with no rebuild.

0.note: Inserts and parent updates land; child-only updates and deletes do not.
Triggered when a child update or delete must propagate.
Insert-only through gold main; wasteful when a full load follows anyway.
Whenever Pipeline A needed one; runs in sequence, off hours only.

1.note: All change classes; parallelism across districts is a separate S3 scaling effort.
No Pipeline B deltas; 20-min stagger between districts, off hours.

2.note: Separate workstream from gold batching. In theory unbounded parallelism; in practice the B→S job fails at scale today (spike in progress, no hard ceiling yet). Blocks this stage's throughput until resolved.
One COPY per staging table per batch; a failing district drops out and retries solo. Open: batch only the staging COPY (SQL still per district in a loop) or batch the Redshift SQL sweep too.

3.note: New rows only; no gold main rebuilds.
Clean and recompute; batched vs one statewide rebuild under evaluation.

independence: Stages 2 and 3 are independent: either may land first.

deciding.head: Where to batch
deciding.body: Batch only the COPY into staging and loop the existing per-district SQL, or batch the Redshift SQL sweep as well (which requires district and year in every join and anti-join).

deciding.head: GM vs GD/P independence
deciding.body: Scope of the rework to run gold main and the derived layer as separate jobs, and whether it lands before or conflicts with batching.

deciding.head: Cost of recompute
deciding.body: Full derived / platinum recompute versus a full gold main refresh, and the benefit G3/G4 adds on top.

deciding.head: Linear or not
deciding.body: Derived / platinum rebuild for 10 districts at a time versus one statewide rebuild.

deciding.head: True bottleneck
deciding.body: Per-step latency in silver-to-gold staging: batch selection, silver read, staging wipe, flatten, COPY wait.

deciding.head: Silver scaling
deciding.body: Why the B→S job fails at scale when its design has no shared write targets (spike in progress, no hard ceiling yet); plus MiDataHub API rate limits.

layers.name: Bronze
layers.desc: Raw archive, append-only batches, one shared table per entity.

layers.name: Silver
layers.desc: Per district, versioned (currentflag), parent / child / grandchild.

layers.name: Gold Stage
layers.desc: 200 shared staging tables; the district slice is wiped then COPYed.

layers.name: Gold Derived
layers.desc: The MiGDL model (22 marts), 39 statements, cross-entity.
